Figure 2. Identification of genes for (� )-vinigrol (1) synthesis. a) LC–MS analysis shows that 1 was produced by V. nigra NBRC 9238 in CSG
medium. b) The chemical structure of 1. c) Phylogenetic tree analysis shows that VniA (diTC-91) does not cluster with the reported diTCs. d) LC–
